title: Reentry Permit - basics
facts: A lawful permanent resident planning extended travel abroad may apply for a reentry permit using Form I-131.
A reentry permit can help show that a permanent resident did not intend to abandon permanent residence during a temporary trip abroad, but it does not guarantee admission to the United States.
A reentry permit does not by itself preserve continuous residence for naturalization.
The applicant must generally be physically present in the United States when filing a reentry-permit application and must comply with biometrics requirements.
